cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(thermostat LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(WIN32)
    set(PLATFORM_SOURCES gctrl_udp_windows.cpp)
    set(PLATFORM_LIBS ws2_32)
else()
    set(PLATFORM_SOURCES gctrl_udp_linux.cpp)
    set(PLATFORM_LIBS pthread)
endif()

add_executable(thermostat
    ../thermostat.cpp
    ${PLATFORM_SOURCES}
)

target_link_libraries(thermostat PRIVATE ${PLATFORM_LIBS})
target_include_directories(thermostat PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/..
)

set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
set_target_properties(thermostat PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin
)

if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(thermostat PRIVATE
        $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-g>
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-O2 -DNDEBUG>
    )
endif()
